value.rationale: Complete, natural parametric D-optimal pinning allocation on all complete bipartite graphs with two vertex-cost tiers and arbitrary independent gains. The sharp low-side activation exists if and only if B<q², while the high-side cutoff is an exact rational function; equal prices exhibit a sharp graph-imbalance budget threshold. This nontrivial support geometry controls rooted-forest reweighting and Gaussian precision/uncertainty volume design, unlike routine evaluation of one graph or an arbitrary slice.
